question: Which cache policy should apply after the complete imported inventory gate?
decision: Make interface-only --module-interface-cache consumers strict by default, expose --module-cache-fallback for explicit source fallback, and retain source fallback for --emit-module-bytecode module-product cold builds and repairs.
option_rules: --module-cache-fallback is only valid for interface-only cache consumers
--module-cache-strict still requires an explicit cache directory

compatibility_boundary.cdi: cdi 0.1 unchanged; legacy sidecars remain readable

old_path_deletion_condition: Do not remove dependency-body checking or module-product source fallback until a separate M3A/M3B decision proves validated artifact coverage for creation and repair while preserving direct-input semantics and diagnostics.
